name: cache-tax
description: cache-tax, the Mod. Everything the hook form does, from inside Claude Code instead of the transcript: stops a cold send once with its price (the resend goes through), keeps the 1-hour prompt cache warm for a window you set with one cache-shared fork per idle stretch, arms that for you after a paid cold write, and keeps score of this session's cold writes. Needs function hooks (early access).
